name: vvv
tagline: Create video templates that can be reused with different photos and copy
description: Vibe Vision Video provides a skill that agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others can install to generate short videos from reusable templates. Users select a template (wedding, comedy, doodle, etc.), supply photos, names, dates, copy and music, and the skill measures the reference video, rebuilds it with the new assets, checks timing and format, and returns a rendered video and an editable project. A hosted MCP server lets any client browse templates, fetch packages and guides without an account. Community members can also share their own templates. The tool is aimed at developers, video creators and anyone who wants to automate personalized video production.
best_for: Customizing video templates with personal photos
Automating video production for AI agents

free_tier.notes: The hosted MCP server is free with no account required.
